items.briefing:
Quest Apartment Hotels has confirmed a customer data breach caused by a vulnerability in a third-party system, so anyone who has stayed with Quest should monitor their accounts and be alert to suspicious emails or calls. Separately, the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) is warning that a software product called N-able N-central is being actively exploited in Australia right now — organisations using this IT management tool should apply patches immediately. A new unfiltered AI platform called "Kriminal" is also making it easier for cybercriminals to craft scams and malware, raising the risk for everyday users.

Mid-market organisations are being hit hardest by ransomware globally, accounting for 73% of victims — a reminder that businesses of all sizes, including training organisations, remain targets. **Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected email or phone call asking you to verify personal details following the Quest breach, do not engage — contact the company directly

featured.title: Quest Apartment Hotels confirms customer data breach linked to third-party vulnerability
